source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-42

procedures.title: Directional signal switch: replace (Corvette standard and telescoping column)
steps: Under the instrument panel, separate the signal switch harness from the chassis harness at the multiple connector.
Remove the steering wheel (see Steering, Section 9).
Take off the preload spring and the cancelling cam.
Remove the screw holding the directional signal lever, then the lever.
Push the hazard warning knob in, unscrew it and remove it.
Remove the screws holding the lower trim cover, then the cover.
Take the retaining ring and the thrust and wave washers off the top end of the shaft.
notes: See figure 57 in the manual (telescoping column).
Tilt column steps 18-26 (Chevrolet, Chevelle, Camaro) at the top of the page are not Corvette.
